operativeNote.procedureName: MIS-TLIF L4-L5 with Bilateral Percutaneous Pedicle Screws (Medtronic Voyager) & PEEK Capstone Cage
operativeNote.incisionDetails: Two 3.2cm Wiltse paramedian incisions 4.5cm lateral to midline over L4-L5.
operativeNote.decompressionDetails: Complete right L4-L5 facetectomy and hemi-laminectomy under 22mm expandable tubular retractor. Traversing L5 root mobilized medially without tension. Exiting L4 root probed and verified free.
operativeNote.discectomyDetails: Radical L4-L5 discectomy. Endplates prepared with box curettes to bleeding subchondral bone.
operativeNote.interbodyFusionDetails: Bullet PEEK cage (10x28mm, 4° lordosis) packed with local autograft and DBM putty placed in anterior 1/3 of disc space.
operativeNote.instrumentationDetails: Bilateral cannulated percutaneous pedicle screws placed: L4 Bilateral 6.5x45mm; L5 Bilateral 6.5x45mm. 5.5mm pre-bent Ti rods seated and torqued to shear-off.
operativeNote.boneGraftUsed: Autologous facet bone chips + 2.5cc DBM Putty.
operativeNote.hemostasisAndClosure: Floseal applied. No bleeding. Fascia closed with 0-Vicryl, skin with 3-0 Monocryl subcuticular.

neuromonitoring.baselineNotes: SSEP and MEP baseline reliable in all lower extremity muscle groups.
neuromonitoring.intraopEvents: Triggered EMG of screws verified > 15 mA threshold bilaterally (no pedicle breach).

operativeNote.immediatePostOpPlan: Mobilize POD 1. Drain out when < 30ml/24h. LSO brace when upright.

dischargeSummary.hospitalCourseSummary: 54-year-old gentleman admitted with severe neurogenic claudication and bilateral L5 radiculopathy secondary to L4-L5 Grade 1 Degenerative Spondylolisthesis. Underwent uneventful MIS-TLIF L4-L5 on 07/09/2026 performed by Dr. Bharat Dave & Dr. Amritesh Singh. Post-operatively, patient noted immediate dramatic relief of radicular leg symptoms. Mobilized on POD 1 with walker and progressed to independent ambulation with rigid LSO brace on POD 2. Drain removed on POD 2 (output 22ml/24h). Foley catheter removed and patient voiding clear with normal bowel habits. Wound is clean and dry.
dischargeSummary.operativeSummaryBrief: MIS-TLIF L4-L5 with Medtronic Voyager bilateral percutaneous pedicle screws (6.5x45mm) and Capstone PEEK cage (10x28mm 4°). Autologous facet bone + DBM putty. EBL 110ml.
dischargeSummary.implantsSummary: 4x Titanium Pedicle Screws (6.5x45mm), 1x PEEK Interbody Cage (10x28mm), 2x Ti Rods (5.5mm).
dischargeSummary.dischargeNeuroStatus: Independent ambulation with LSO brace. Motor power 5/5 in all bilateral lower extremity myotomes (L2 through S1). Dermatomes intact. Normal sphincter control.
dischargeSummary.woundConditionAtDischarge: Two 3cm paramedian surgical wounds clean, dry, well-apposed. No signs of erythema, discharge, or induration.
dischargeSummary.drainRemovalDateAndTotal: Removed on POD 2 (09/09/2026). Total cumulative drainage: 87 ml.
dischargeSummary.mobilityAtDischarge: Ambulatory with walker and LSO rigid brace
dischargeSummary.braceInstructions: LSO rigid spinal brace to be worn continuously whenever out of bed (sitting, standing, or walking) for 6 weeks. May be removed only while sleeping flat in bed.
spinalPrecautions: Strict log-rolling technique when getting in and out of bed.
No forward or sideways bending at the waist; bend from knees and hips.
No lifting objects heavier than 3 kg (approx. 1 filled kettle) for 6 weeks.
No sudden twisting or rotating of the torso.
Sitting duration limited to 30-40 minutes at a time; take short strolls between sitting intervals.
redFlagWarnings: Sudden loss of bowel or bladder control, or numbness around the saddle/perineal area (Cauda Equina warning).
Sudden onset of new weakness in foot (inability to lift toes or walk on heels).
High-grade fever (> 100.4°F / 38°C) with chills or wound discharge/redness.
Clear, watery fluid discharge from the surgical incision (suspicion of CSF leak).
